questions.q: The man ___ called you is my boss.
The book ___ I read was great.
The girl ___ bag was stolen is here.
My sister, ___ lives in Paris, is a doctor.
questions.why: У non-defining (з комами) that не вживається; для людей — who.

questions.q: In "The man who I met yesterday is a doctor", can 'who' be omitted?
questions.why: Відносне слово-додаток у defining clause можна опустити.

questions.q: He passed the exam, ___ surprised everyone.
questions.why: which може відносити всю попередню ситуацію.

questions.q: I remember the day ___ we met. (when / that)

options: The teacher, that helped me, is kind.
The teacher who helped me is kind.
The teacher which helped me is kind.
The teacher whose helped me is kind.
questions.why: Для людей — who; that не вживається в non-defining.

answer: The woman who lives next door is a nurse
questions.why: who — про людей (defining clause, без ком).
